reproduction.matrix: 12 page/viewport combos x (30/60/120/180)s idle + tab-switch + back-forward + drawer + nav-idle scenarios + 6 shell-page link checks
reproduction.conclusion: No code-level idle-interaction failure reproduced in real Chromium (headless + headed). Pages remained clickable, scrollable and keyboard-usable after 180s idle; zero console errors, zero network errors, no stuck overlays, no scroll locks, pointer-events:auto throughout.

rootCause.codeLevel: Static scan + browser reproduction cleared all code-level suspects: no timers >=60s (only js/mailer.js 15s abort), no orphan setInterval, no global pointer-events/inert, bounded scroll-restore (1200ms ceiling, cancels on interaction), clean service worker, analytics disabled by default, no full-screen loading layers.

eliminatedSuspects.risk: Known Chromium bug class: a stuck old-document snapshot can leave the page unclickable until refresh
eliminatedSuspects.action: Removed from css/style.min.css (base rule + reduced-motion override). Cosmetic-only; removed per stability>effects.

eliminatedSuspects.suspect: Stale body.no-scroll / body{position:fixed} scroll lock (drawer + booking modal share lockScroll/unlockScroll)
eliminatedSuspects.risk: If a lock outlives its owner (tab switch, bfcache, interrupted close) the page is frozen at a fixed offset and cannot scroll
eliminatedSuspects.action: Added js/recovery.js self-healing watchdog (releases orphaned no-scroll, clears fixed top, restores scroll).

eliminatedSuspects.risk: Full-viewport fixed inset:0 z-index:99 backdrop blocks all clicks when nav-open sticks
eliminatedSuspects.action: Watchdog removes nav-open/no-scroll when no drawer is actually open.

eliminatedSuspects.suspect: AdSense Auto Ads overlays (vignette/anchor/in-page) injected at runtime (~30-120s)
eliminatedSuspects.risk: Third-party overlays can cover the page; not reproducible on a local build (ads are not served on localhost)
eliminatedSuspects.action: Site overlays sit above ads; watchdog never touches ad iframes; owner should disable/limit Vignette + Anchor ads in the AdSense Auto ads dashboard if they block interaction (documented below).

fix.watchdog: Added js/recovery.js (self-healing: stale scroll-lock, stale nav-open/backdrop, pointer-events:none on html/body, stale inert, unexpected full-viewport overlay; incidents exposed via window.EkGuruRecovery.incidents() for admin Diagnostics).
fix.injection: tools/inject-recovery.py inserted <script src=...js/recovery.js defer> into 577/578 pages (Google site-verification file intentionally untouched).
fix.serviceWorker: Added ./js/recovery.js to sw.js SHELL precache list.
fix.verification: Watchdog unit test PASS (5/5 self-heals; healthy state preserved; 0 console errors). Post-fix 180s matrix PASS.
